title: Protect your stokvel: 3 simple rules #Stokvel
text:
One: a constitution signed by every member (how much, by when, what happens if someone falls behind or leaves, who the chairperson and treasurer are, how payouts work). NASASA has templates. Two: a separate stokvel bank account, never one member's personal account. Three: no single person can take money out: at least two of three signatories approve every payment.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
